sources.title: DEWA accelerates Dubai's shift to sustainable mobility
sources.supports: 47,944 EVs at end-2025; 37,486 a year earlier; over 1,860 charging points; 23,600 registered users by mid-January 2026
sources.limitations: Vehicles, users and charging points are distinct populations; not unmet-demand estimates.

sources.title: Mobile EV charging Dubai
sources.supports: Advertised mobile delivery; 30 kWh AED 109 + VAT and 50 kWh AED 159 + VAT
sources.limitations: Company-advertised service and prices, not independently verified operating outcomes or transaction data.

sources.title: EV charging service guide
sources.supports: Public charging service and guest access
sources.limitations: Does not establish exact approval requirements for the proposed mobile pilot.

sources.title: Regulatory framework for EV charging infrastructure
sources.supports: Official regulatory reference linked from the service guide
sources.limitations: Pilot-specific legal and safety requirements need qualified confirmation.
